name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 9 visits over 73 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2025-11-13, at wavelengths from 0.94 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
